risk: Changing the constant could break parsing, transport, security checks, or implementation dispatch.
justification: Individually reviewed all three values: paid, pending, closed. They are a presentation grouping of server payment statuses for the Mis entradas page (EVT-MY-TICKETS-001). They are never stored, sent to the server, selected by a user or used in an access decision; the server status remains authoritative and unknown statuses fall to 'closed' (no valid tickets), never to paid.
